name: Branchless Ray/AABB Intersection with NaN Handling
aliases: Fast Branchless Ray/Bounding Box Intersection Part 2
definition: An algorithm to compute ray-axis-aligned bounding box intersections that eliminates branches by using precomputed inverse ray directions and relies on IEEE 754 floating point properties, specifically handling the edge case where a ray lies exactly on a slab boundary (origin coordinate equals min or max), which produces NaN via 0 * infinity.
